methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified 2026-06-19. Specs confirmed against manufacturer pages (Bonsaii/bonsaiishop.com, Aurora auroradirectstore/auroracorp, Fellowes, Royal) and US retailers (Staples, Newegg, Amazon). Prices are published US retail/MSRP from a live primary or reputable retailer page; where only a deal-aggregator or renewed listing existed, priceUsd is set to null. bin_capacity_gal in US gallons; continuous_run_min is manufacturer-stated max uninterrupted run before cool-down; booleans mean feature present. All 12 named models verified to exist (none fabricated). Key corrections this pass: Amazon Basics 12-sheet source URL repointed to the current 'New Model' (B0C6LZG69W) whose 5-gal/9-min/P-3 specs match the listed values (the draft's B07VPQHZHC URL is the older 1.8-gal/8-min variant); Bonsaii C144-D price corrected to match its own cited source; Royal 1840MX security_level nulled (no source states P-4); Amazon Basics 8-sheet micro-cut price nulled (no primary published USD price). accessedAt 2026-06-19.
